lifecycle.activation_contract: Extension Manager/ECPA forwards the hash-bound experimental configuration to StateAxis; the host admits only the bounded 64-state, single-victim, fail-closed bitmap path.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable the extension or omit --additional-config; StateAxis then retains the unchanged full-sort eviction authority.

supported_workloads: experimental StateAxis Native Engine runs with at most 64 resident states and exactly one required victim
out_of_scope: automatic inheritance from StateAxis aggregate evidence

performance_claims.label: not-beneficial-in-tested-cell
performance_claims.result: Selections were equivalent, but the incremental selector was slower than full sort.

performance_claims.label: component-repeated-crossover-positive
performance_claims.result: The bounded bitmap path reduced 17-state single-victim P50 by 65.12%; bulk selection remains on full sort.

performance_claims.label: matched-real-online-mixed-unqualified
performance_claims.scope: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, eager BF16, one Ascend 910B2, 17-state capacity, sequential 64-request churn workload
performance_claims.result: Three paired request-throughput deltas were -1.276%, +0.005%, and +3.257% (median +0.005%); signs did not repeat, so no online gain is qualified.
